ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: <image1> is a schematic map of China's energy resource curse zoning. The legend in the lower left divides areas into "resource curse areas, resource curse marginal areas, resource curse severe areas, resource curse high-risk areas", etc., among which the "resource curse high-risk areas" are represented by the densest grid/deeper symbols and are distributed in some areas related to energy resource enrichment. Then reason: the text material explains that the resource curse is due to economic development depending excessively on resources, leading to distortion of the industrial structure. The high-risk areas both correspond to resource enrichment and high risk, and also reflect dependence on resource development and primary product production, so their industrial structure is dominated by primary industries.
